about: Eventer Technologies Ltd operates as a software company engaged in the development and operation of a cloud-based technology platform for the event management industry in Israel. The company develops a platform for the management and sale of tickets for events of various types, including performances, festivals, courses, lectures, conferences and other activities. The company offers two main software platforms, the ticket sales and event management platform which includes optional integrated payment processing; and the event advertising platform, Eventer Backstage. Its platform is a cloud-based solution that enables event organizers to set up, publish, manage and sell tickets for their events. It provides event organizers with a comprehensive suite of tools for planning, pricing and marketing events effectively, including real-time data collection and statistical analysis of ticket sales information. The company also operates an event advertising service for consumers to browse and discover events listed on its platform. In addition, the company provides ancillary services to event organizers, such as customer service for consumers and ticket buyers, assistance in the sales and marketing of events, and secure payment clearing services through third-party providers. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.
